title: Qualify soft-to-smoke contact
requires: Any development host and one physical production driver advertising the exact capability tuple
scope: Publish and bind vendor-neutral qualification for exactly SOFT_BODY/SMOKE/DISTINCT_FAMILY/CONTACT/FIRST_TO_SECOND/SMOKE_GRID; SOFT_BODY/SMOKE/DISTINCT_FAMILY/CONTACT/FIRST_TO_SECOND/SMOKE_PARTICLE. The single physical behavior is: A bound soft-body surface redirects particle and grid smoke without applying an unadvertised reverse mechanical response.
acceptance: Publish one immutable analytic profile for the listed tuple or representation variants, with canonical public-API inputs, SI units, bounded tolerances and an oracle independent of driver-private state.
Add exact bounded capacity, replacement, removal and rollback lifecycle checks; a rejected mutation preserves the last usable state and recovery is deterministic.

Bind only the exact tuple records in capability-obligations-v1 and rebuild the evidence index; retain failures, leave unrecaptured drivers unqualified, and remove any production advertisement that cannot satisfy the contract.

history.reason: Published an immutable paired public-state soft-body-to-smoke CONTACT oracle for particle and grid smoke, added exact grid graph lifecycle coverage, retained the exact particle adverse lifecycle binding, and produced clean physical CUDA qualification for both exact CONTACT tuples without broadening into DRAG.
